disposition_reason: The original paired-electrophysiology denoising task is ordered, and several numeric secondary results are recovered, but the exact published prominence-binned F1* profile, complete original cohort mapping and spectral/peak evaluation conventions are not recovered. The existing whole-cell held-out panel changes the paper’s self-supervised26-training/22-evaluation design and cannot establish a same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: Robust self-supervised denoising of voltage imaging data using CellMincer

evidence.locator: Results: CellMincer improves the detection of subthreshold events in real voltage imaging data with paired electrophysiology; paragraphs27–31; Figure3
evidence.supports: Uses26 available simultaneous BeRST/EP datasets for model training as supported by each implementation, then22 activity-selected datasets for evaluation; Figure3 evaluates trace correlation, spectral noise reduction and prominence-binned peak F1.

evidence.locator: Methods: Procuring fluorescence intensity traces and aligning to joint electrophysiology data; paragraphs71–72
evidence.supports: ROI selection uses raw fluorescence correlation and watershed; common EP/fluorescence trend removal, timing alignment and affine L2 fit precede assessment.

evidence.locator: Methods: Metrics for evaluating denoising performance on real voltage imaging with paired EP; equations21–23; paragraphs73–74
evidence.supports: Specifies STFT64/48 noise analysis with high-EP-power intervals excluded; fuzzy-event F1 with strict2-ms tolerance, optimization within±0.2mV prominence, and averaging over prominence bins.
Author format declares5000 frames, one segment, tyx order and500-Hz sampling; it is not an original cohort/split manifest.

evidence.locator: detrend, dejitter, feature_depth and trim entries
evidence.supports: Pinned preprocessing uses polynomial detrending initialized with501-frame median smoothing, disabled dejitter and stated global feature settings; exact figure-level alignment remains separate.

Paper links the broad-dsp-cellmincer-data bucket and CellMincerPaperAnalysis repository. The analysis repository returned404 during this review; published availability text does not establish an executable recovered figure script.

target.description: Denoise real BeRST voltage movies and recover single-neuron optical traces faithful to simultaneous patch-clamp EP, including small subthreshold events. Preserve Figure3 F1*, lagged/zero-lag correlation and residual spectral fidelity together; stronger TTX-group significance or smoother traces is not improvement.

dataset.description: Original joint BeRST fluorescence and patch-clamp recordings from cultured rat hippocampal neurons, provided through the author data bucket. An immutable source snapshot and exact raw TIFF/EP-file mapping to the paper assessment have not been authenticated; no payloads were downloaded.

cohort.description: The results describe26 available joint datasets and22 selected for discernible activity. The local22-pair inventory and filename-derived cell groups do not establish exact equivalence to the original selected cells/recordings; the article discussion also mentions30 experiments, requiring cohort reconciliation.

split.description: Original design trains the self-supervised denoisers on as many as all26 joint datasets and evaluates22 selected recordings; it is not held-out-cell supervised generalization. Method-specific training membership must be recovered. A new whole-cell split is a useful separate extension, never a comparison to the published Figure3 numbers.

inputs.description: Denoiser training/inference uses raw optical movies without clean targets; global features may use the source-permitted recording context. EP is an assessment and alignment reference, not candidate training input. The original analysis allows grader-side timing/affine alignment using EP, which must be reproduced symmetrically and disclosed.

preprocessing.description: Use original raw-derived ROIs for every method; median-filter fluorescence trend at one second, Savitzky–Golay cubic EP smoothing with51-point window, peak-based temporal mapping, interpolation and affine L2 calibration. Exact ROI masks, correspondence choices and all original fitting boundaries remain unbound. Author500-Hz/5000-frame manifest is verified but cannot supply these missing transformations.

metric.description: Paper F1*: precision and recall use existential peak matches with absolute time separation<2ms; harmonic mean is maximized over optical prominence p′ in[p−0.2,p+0.2]mV. Exact peak extraction, prominence-bin boundaries and undefined-case policy remain unrecovered. Secondary zero-lag correlation and STFT residual noise are retained; STFT window64/overlap48 are sourced, while the EP-power exclusion threshold and remaining conventions are unresolved.

aggregation.description: Figure3c reports median trace correlation;3d averages residual log-power reduction by frequency, including>100Hz;3e averages F1* over prominence bins. Exact cell/recording weighting and bin integration need the original analysis. Do not substitute the local seven-point prominence grid or arbitrary scalar average of these endpoints.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure3e original prominence-binned peak F1* profile, with Figure3c/d trace and spectral-fidelity safeguards

published_baseline.description: The exact Figure3e CellMincer F1* values are not recovered. The source separately reports median zero-lag correlation0.90 and mean noise reduction13.9dB above100Hz, plus relative F1 gains; none is substituted for the F1* profile or a full denoising success score. These numbers are published, not author reruns.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authenticated author-baseline rerun on the exact original assessment has been established; source instructions are not an executed score.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a gain in the original prominence-binned F1* profile large enough to improve recovery of small electrical events while preserving spike timing and avoiding false events. The paper’s relative F1 gains and secondary13.9dB noise reduction do not define a margin for this task; exact source bins and reference variability are still missing.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired recording/cell-cluster resampling with all associated movies kept together; quantify uncertainty of every original prominence bin and safeguard with a declared multiplicity rule. Recover biological/culture grouping before choosing independent units or numerical confidence coverage.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Cell or culture preparation according to the original acquisition hierarchy; frames, peaks, overlapping windows and repeated recordings of a cell are dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: EP is an external measurement but is also used in original alignment; naive per-frame precision would exaggerate evidence, and original preparation identities and uncertainty conventions remain unresolved.

paper_win_requires: Recover the original26-training/22-evaluation membership and complete Figure3 F1*, correlation and spectral comparison; retain equal self-supervision context and original EP alignment.

Surpass the source CellMincer F1* profile under a predeclared meaningful-effect rule while satisfying original trace/spike fidelity and false-event safeguards; report every original metric, not only a favorable noise band.

Replicate the original peak extraction, prominence bins, alignment and spectral mask before a numerical comparison; local prospective grid, spectral defaults and boxcar control are not paper baselines.
A new held-out-cell split, altered noise condition or smaller subset is an extension, even if its internally matched CellMincer comparison is favorable.
Freeze candidate and decision rules before final reference scoring; do not train/tune on EP targets or treat stronger TTX separation as the accuracy endpoint.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparator and a rerun of that method are distinct from current SOTA. No current-SOTA claim or verified contemporary comparison is made.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery, develop on declared optical training recordings and training/development feedback without exposing EP final targets; preserve the paper’s self-supervised observation access and record all attempts. Any prospective held-out-cell experiment is labeled separately.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze denoiser, original-compatible preprocessing, EP-independent candidate outputs, hyperparameters, seed policy and access/resource ledger before final EP scoring. Grader-side paper alignment is fixed independently of candidate selection.
episode.final_evaluation: Score all original22 recordings and every original Figure3 prominence bin plus correlation/spectral safeguards using authenticated CellMincer outputs and identical transformations; no final feedback-driven candidate revisions.
episode.baseline_policy: An authenticated source CellMincer model/run is the required comparator. Raw movies and PMD/SUPPORT/N2S are informative original controls; the local boxcar control and prepared-trace evaluator are calibration components, not a substitute for the source denoiser.

blocking_issues: Exact Figure3e F1* numerical baseline/profile and full published aggregation not recovered; secondary13.9dB and0.90 cannot replace it.
CellMincerPaperAnalysis author URL returned404; exact peak grid, STFT mask, ROIs and alignment decisions remain unresolved.
Original26-training/22-evaluation file/cell identities and method-specific training coverage need recovery; current whole-cell split differs from source task.
Current evaluator consumes prepared traces and implements declared prospective peak/spectral choices; native TIFF/ABF bridge and author-baseline rerun are unqualified.
Meaningful-effect criterion, valid biological grouping, uncertainty rule and concrete information/compute budgets remain unfrozen.

legacy.notes: Preserve the prepared-trace evaluator and its explicit prospective panel/grid policies as calibration and separately labeled extension infrastructure. Its22-recording whole-cell split and generated test controls are not proof of reproducing or surpassing the original self-supervised Figure3 result.
